boundaries: Candidates, lineage, budgets, and the four proxy fields.
Capability-scoped. Enumerates exactly what may cross.
Rubric internals, per-criterion detail, grader prompts.
Heldout essays and the frozen grader outcome.
confidence: None for the v0.7 adapter; the REB-063 prompt result is historical evidence, not proof of this adapter.
hypothesis: A capability-scoped verifier proxy can drive prompt, preference and reward optimization without ever exposing rubric internals or heldout essays.

panels.caption: Four fields cross the proxy: score, rank, weakest dimension, and the hints explicitly allowed. Everything else stays sealed.
notes: Verifier reward may saturate; reward-model fidelity is reported alongside it rather than assumed.
Selection never reads the frozen heldout grader.

title: VZPO
verdict: Measurement spine exists as REB evidence. The hosted adapter is not built.
why: REB-063/064/065 establish the wall, the pins and the substrates. Extracting them into a reusable hosted adapter, and bounding the provider TPM retry defect, is outstanding work.
